quest.514D1112BAB39A83.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Iron Pickaxe (minecraft:iron_pickaxe). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 64 × Cobblestone (minecraft:cobblestone). The items are not consumed by this task.

Use an iron pickaxe and FTB Ultimine to successfully break at least two different blocks in one grouped operation. Ordinary mining does not count. The separate item tasks detect the pickaxe and 64 cobblestone without consuming them. Check Controls for FTB Ultimine and preview the selected area before breaking it.
quest.514D1112BAB39A83.title: Mine a Group with Ultimine
quest.514D1118E4523B29.quest_desc: Reach 1 on the native statistic chancecubes:opened_chance_cube. For Chance Cubes this records actually opened cubes.
quest.514D1118E4523B29.title: Opened Chance Cube: 1
quest.514D111AFD4E2789.quest_desc: Prepare a compass, 32 torches and a water bucket. The item tasks check inventory without consuming anything; also bring food, tool durability and a marked return route.

Then choose any discoveries available around you. The compass points to its vanilla target and does not locate structures automatically. Visiting a particular bridge, village, tavern or biome is not required to continue the quests.
quest.514D111AFD4E2789.title: A Small Expedition Kit
quest.514D113C4B748351.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Chance Cube (chancecubes:chance_cube). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.514D113C4B748351.title: Obtain 1 × Chance Cube
quest.514D11628A7DD0E1.quest_desc: Optional expedition: find a generated Abridged bridge and enter its structure. A player-built bridge does not satisfy the location check.

The reward remains available, but this visit unlocks and blocks no later quest. If the bridge is far away, continue preparation, trading and other objectives. In an existing explored world, look for newly added structures in new chunks.
quest.514D11628A7DD0E1.title: Visit Bridge
quest.514D11824471BA9B.title: Enter The End
quest.514D118E5C7AB43A.quest_desc: After the equipment and workshop summary, hold a compass in your inventory. The task does not consume it or require any particular generated location.
Trading, structure visits and opening a Chance Cube are separate optional activities. Choose them when useful and return to production when you have the materials you need.
quest.514D118E5C7AB43A.title: Expedition Checklist
quest.514D11A7ED9AA3BB.quest_desc: Complete the expedition kit and Industrial Chassis quests. These are the two conditions for this summary: equipment for a return journey and a prepared workshop.

The summary completes automatically from those dependencies. No particular bridge, underground village or tavern must be found. Mark your base and chosen direction on the map; building a road remains your own project.
quest.514D11A7ED9AA3BB.title: Equipment and Workshop Ready
quest.514D11B7AEB78396.title: Enter The Nether
quest.514D11CDA1129F03.quest_desc: Optional expedition: enter a real Underground Village. This generated structure is separate from Millénaire settlements.

Prepare a lit route back to the surface. The visit is detected automatically within the structure. Trading and expedition readiness are available without this visit; dismantling the village or moving its villagers is unnecessary.
quest.514D11CDA1129F03.title: Visit Underground Village
quest.514D11E0ED42C1FF.quest_desc: Complete a normal villager trade to earn the vanilla What a Deal! advancement. A trader in a surface village or at your base can satisfy it.
An Underground Village is not required: this optional branch opens after the expedition kit. Trading does not block the readiness summary or later expeditions.
quest.514D11E0ED42C1FF.title: Trade with Any Villager
